tailoring.headline: SAP BTP Integration Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, designing and operating end-to-end data pipelines that integrate PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven track record of API migrations, performance tuning, CI/CD deployments and production support. Strong techno-functional consulting experience, translating business requirements into scalable integration designs for SAP CX environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP BTP Integration Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Susmitha G’s focus on SAP BTP integration for SAP CX landscapes. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep expertise in Java-based API design, data pipeline orchestration and ERP/MDM integrations that align perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: API Design
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and exposed OCC REST web services and led API migrations, ensuring robust, versioned interfaces for storefront and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Data Integration
bullets.text: I built end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, synchronizing product data across SAP ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: I collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and seamless SAP Commerce implementations.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) and provided 24/7 production support, optimizing performance and resolving integration incidents.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026.

tailoring.why_company: Susmitha G’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge SAP BTP integration projects for SAP CX customers resonates with my passion for bridging business needs and technology. Your commitment to innovative, end-to-end solutions across ERP and MDM platforms matches my experience designing robust data pipelines and API ecosystems at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am eager to contribute my Java-centric integration expertise to help your clients accelerate digital transformation on the SAP Business Technology Platform.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Susmitha G to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud integration expertise to ambitious BTP projects, driving seamless CX experiences for global enterprises.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years of integration experience. I’m keen on the SAP BTP Integration Consultant role at Susmitha G and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP BTP Integration Consultant – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP BTP Integration Consultant position. With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring and complex ERP/MDM integrations, I am confident I can contribute to your integration initiatives. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.

Best regards
